name: Changchun BCHT Biotechnology Co.
summary: Changchun BCHT Biotechnology Co. Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical enterprise primarily focused on the research, development, production, and global commercialization of vaccines designed for human use. Its extensive product portfolio features key immunizations such as attenuated (live) herpes zoster and varicella vaccines, alongside a live, nasal, and freeze-dried influenza vaccine, and a rabies vaccine utilizing vero cell technology. This company was established in 2004 and is headquartered in Changchun, China.
